call_purpose: You wanted to offer monthly and yearly plans on one checkout page, send customers to your own thank-you page after payment, add GST to your prices, and add your privacy policy link to your checkout footer.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you added a yearly price to your product, and you confirmed that both the monthly and yearly options now show on your checkout page.

Following our guidance, you pasted your thank-you page link into the After purchase redirect option in your product's Pages settings and saved it, and a test purchase took you straight to your thank-you page.
